title: Enforce origin-signature verification on POST /sos (silent drop)
description: Decomposed from project-LICHEN-worker6-a6qg gap 1. Spec 12-apps.md 18.4.1: SOS MUST carry a valid link-layer origin signature; unsigned/invalid are silently dropped. verify_sos_origin()/SosOriginSignature (lichen.coap.sos_origin) exist with zero production callers; SosResource.render_post accepts unsigned {node,ts} bodies with 2.01. The xfail(strict) pin lives in python/tests/coap/test_security_app_vector_consumers.py::test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped (asserts unsuccessful response). DESIGN DECISION NEEDED (owner): the signed POST wire format — spec 18.4.3's local-POST example body has no signature fields; proposal: body gains 'pubkey' (32B bstr) + 'origin_sig' (56B bstr = seq||sig per SosOriginSignature.to_bytes), verify via verify_sos_origin(pub, fe80::IID(pub), canonicalize_sos_payload(body-minus-sig-fields), sig); missing/invalid -> reject without activating or recording rate-limit state. Enforcement ripples: ~10 green tests across test_security_app_vector_consumers.py and test_sos_resource.py POST unsigned bodies and expect 2.01/4.29 — they must switch to signed bodies with derived keypairs (fixed hex IIDs like 0011223344556677 do not correspond to any keypair). Also check relay path wiring (SosRelay gate) and lichen-apps/rust parity.
